meta.label: Sleep debt
meta.rationale: Computed from several measurements; inherits their confidence.

explain.text: Accumulated shortfall against your sleep need, with old debt fading: each night, debt = 0.931 × yesterday's debt + (need − sleep). The decay alone halves standing debt in about 9.7 days. It is set from the recovery literature, where clearing roughly ten hours of debt takes days of extended sleep, not one long lie-in. The subtraction is symmetric and has no floor: sleeping past your need repays debt hour for hour, and a sustained surplus can carry debt below zero, because banked sleep genuinely buys resilience. Naps count as sleep. A night with no recording holds debt where it is — an unworn ring is not evidence you caught up.
